title: Activation-only vs D9 vs native checkpointing: a system-level feasibility screen
checkpoint_baseline: native forward/backward with per-GPT2-block torch.utils.checkpoint(checkpoint,use_reentrant=False), not HF model.forward
memory_measurement: peak allocated/reserved for full training step excluding extra final probe; no full-probe peak contamination
time_measurement: CUDA synchronized end-to-end forward/backward/clipping/optimizer, median excluding first step, throughput uses input tokens
update_quality: relative loss differences for 8-step controlled historical training and fixed non-training diagnostic prompt set, not independent generalization
no_alg_optimization: No changes to original EM4/D9 math, no Triton sign kernel, no layer search or new codec
not_equivalent: PyTorch AdamW uses FP32 m,v; D9 uses compressed quantization and is NOT bitwise-equivalent to FP32 AdamW
decision: Only recommend further activation-only B1 if 2/3 memory>=5%, step ratio<=1.25, relative loss<=1%; record checkpoint Pareto separately
failure_policy: always save partial results with exception details and no promotion
